key_insight: This paper shows that large language models can look competent on static clinical cases but fail to identify, use, and update with the right evidence during dynamic diagnosis.
clinical_relevance: The work helps explain why LLMs may miss important follow-up information in real clinical workflows, highlighting limits in evidence tracking and diagnostic updating.
method: Dissects failure across evidence identification, evidence use, and diagnostic updating.
Evaluates not just accuracy, but also evidence coverage, trajectory dynamics, probability, and information entropy.
Includes breakdown, pre-event, and post-event analyses plus verification and generalization tests.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments spanning capability breakdown, pre-event state before evidence arrives, post-event state transition after evidence arrives, and broader verification/generalization analyses.
watch_item: These findings are diagnostic-system focused and do not imply safe clinical deployment without further validation in real-world settings.
paper_title: From Hindsight to Foresight: Dissecting Clinical Evidence Acquisition in Large Language Models
